scope: Minimal Windows native evaluator for a fresh private staged CJS input tree and locked check, through the ordinary broker with zero-capability AppContainer and a native Job fence.
observedControls: Runtime, check, files and directories bound to immutable issued startup policy; native identity/digest/reparse/link validation
Read-only staged source/control and separate writable scratch
Source/check overwrite, source deletion, workspace rename and hardlink attempts rejected
Changed staged source rejected before target creation (targetPid=0)
Native wall-time watchdog and whole-Job cleanup
A real detached descendant and parent observed absent after native completion
Provider environment variables absent in the checked target

networkEvidence.interpretation: This host's public connection returned EACCES; loopback returned ETIMEDOUT. Loopback evidence combines the native policy checks, reachable listener before and after, and no extra accepted connections. ETIMEDOUT is not rewritten as an explicit access-denied error.

caveats: Results are local Windows evidence, not an authoritative release gate or cross-platform certification.

The zero-capability/token/profile preparation behavior differs between the restricted Codex sandbox account and the real-user run; successful final results do not generalize to the restricted account.
Historical failure receipts are diagnostic records, not retroactively successful observations; some omit the harness assertion that failed after native completion.
The token-fixed historical receipt has explicitly unreliable startup source binding because its original producer hashed files after concurrent edits.
The already-hashed supervisor identity remains pseudonymous; raw account names and user-path prefixes are omitted.

redaction.method: Recursively redact only absolute user-profile and repository prefixes in JSON string values, then pretty-print JSON. Raw source and archived byte digests permit explicit distinction; originals remain in local .work.
redaction.limitation: Pattern and available environment-value checks do not constitute an exhaustive secret detector. These inputs are scoped native sandbox diagnostics and test results.

Historical source digest fields are preserved as reported, not certified against the final implementation.
